subject: general
question:
In the given figure, l₁ || l₂ and p is their transversal with angle 4 = 5x + 35° and angle 7 = 45°. Find the value of x.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ef348a9d9fe0dae20f18604692a1594f8992200e0355aeb863c168897b4f26b.png]
solution:
**Given:**

l₁ || l₂ and p is their transversal.

Angle 7 = 45° 

angle 4 = 5x + 35°

**Concept used:**

If two parallel lines are cut by a transversal line then,

 
• each pair of alternate interior angles are equal.
 
• each pair of interior angles on the same side of the transversal are supplementary, i.e. they add up to 180 degrees.
 
• each pair of corresponding angles are equal in measure.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ef348a9d9fe0dae20f18604692a1594f8992200e0355aeb863c168897b4f26b.png] 

angle 7 = angle 6 = 45° (Equal and opposite angles).

angle 6 = angle 2 = 45° (Corresponding angles are congruent, thus are equal).

angle 2 + angle 4 = 180° (angles on a straight line equals to 180°).

angle 4 = 180° - angle 2

angle 4 = 180° - 45°

angle 4 = 135°

Now, According to the question

angle 4 = 5x + 35°

135° = 5x + 35°

5x = 135° - 35°

5x = 100°

x = 20°

**Hence, the correct answer is '20°'.**
